ai_summary: Aditya Birla Real Estate Limited announced a Board meeting for October 26, 2026, to consider and approve its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. This routine regulatory filing signals the imminent release of the company's Q2 FY27 performance. A standard trading window closure is in effect for designated persons until October 28, 2026, with no apparent red flags in this announcement.
